findings.description: The requirement bounds the interval from enabling to the first refresh and from the last refresh to the end of start-up, but does not define those intervals when start-up ends before any refresh. OP-SWR-001 permits enabling only at the first control cycle, so a start-up with no refresh is a relevant case.
findings.requested_change: Define the applicable intervals when no refresh occurs during start-up, including the transition to the first refresh after start-up.

findings.description: A fault-free start-up followed by a fault before the first refresh under SWR-WDG-004 satisfies this requirement's condition, yet SWR-WDG-001 and SYS-SUP-010 prohibit servicing after detection. The required first refresh therefore conflicts with the stop-servicing obligation.
findings.requested_change: Condition the transition interval on continued fault-free operation through the first refresh, while preserving the prohibition on servicing after fault detection.
